preparation: First B TEST videos and four original frames prepared and transferred once per point
controller: Calibrate using every driver sample in fixed two-second windows; freeze duty before all three measurements
cost_boundary: Whole measured resident service window including compute, synchronization, controller bookkeeping and imposed idle gaps
cost_interpretation: Equivalent service time per16 completed videos, not first200 dataset-once inference latency
energy: (338.2W host proxy + same-window mean board W) * complete service window time / completed videos *16
quality: Existing per-batch full558 SRCC remains separately sourced; repeated firstB outputs are parity evidence, not a new accuracy evaluation
qwen_execution: Native B1; previously equality-validated BatchedVisualQwen B3
low_native_busy_policy: Duty saturates at1; report below-target result without unrelated work or increasing batch
